name: partner-report
description: Collect complete Codex project-session turns every Friday and sync structured facts to Partner Report.

interface.shortDescription: Build a reviewed weekly Partner report
interface.longDescription: Every Friday at 13:00, collect only complete user-question and final-answer turns from configured project folders, extract structured facts locally, and upload them for central aggregation and two-stage web review.
defaultPrompt: Use $partner-report-sync to connect this Codex installation with an Admin binding code.
Use $partner-report-sync to run weekly-collect and return the safe summary.
